newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela scoops Peru gasoil tender - traders.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela scoops Peru gasoil tender - traders.

text.p: Venezuelan oil subsidiary Maraven won most of Peru's 1.6 million barrel gas oil purchase tender for July and August delivery, traders said on Thursday.
Maraven will deliver two 200,000 barrel cargoes in July and four in August, while Colombia's Ecopetrol and traders Vitol will deliver one cargo each in July, they added.
Peru bought 800,000 barrels of gas oil in June, and traders explained the above-normal imports to maintenance at the 62,000 barrel per day Talara refinery, due to start next month.
Peru is a regular buyer of gas oil even when its refineries are working normally, and buys 45 cetane, 0.7 percent sulphur material.
